prompt: Use spirit-forge to distill Paul Graham's writing style from his essays at paulgraham.com, generate a writer skill, then use that skill to write a 500-word essay on 'Why AI startups must be default alive'. Finally, compare the generated essay against actual PG essays for style fidelity.

assertions.text: Generated essay average sentence length is 10-22 words (PG's range)
Generated essay uses at least 2 PG-signature phrases (scheming, naive, default alive, maker's schedule, do things that don't scale, schlep blindness)
Average paragraph length is <=5 sentences (PG's punchy style)
Essay follows PG structure: hook anecdote → insight → generalization → practical takeaway
Tone markers: first-person, conversational, at least 1 contrarian statement, no academic jargon
Generated writer skill has valid SKILL.md with gotchas >=5 describing PG's writing rules
